docs.title: Welcome
docs.text:
Welcome to my personal website. Here you can find information about my professional activities including my resume and projects. The content is a work in progress.

I am primarily interested in the development, operation, and maintenance of the bulk power system in North America.

If you are are interested in working with me, or you have questions about any of the information herein, please reach out to me via LinkedIn.

docs.title: Transmission and distribution study
docs.text:
Personal project

  • Studied transmission and distribution topics including line, generator, and transformer modeling, as well as power-flow analysis.
  • Transmission system analysis in PSS/E.
  • Distribution system analysis in Milsoft WindMil.

docs.title: Modeling and simulation of a DFIG-based wind turbine
docs.text:
EE 5590 Electromechanical Wind Energy Conversion and Grid Integration, Iowa State University

  • Modeled and simulated a DFIG-based wind turbine and associated power electronics for grid integration.
  • Performed analysis in MATLAB and PLECS.

docs.title: IEEE 30-bus system study
docs.text:
EE 5530 Steady State Analysis, Iowa State University

  • Developed and ran algorithms for power systems analysis, including power flow, optimal power flow, economic dispatch, contingency analysis, and security-constrained optimal power flow.
  • Performed analysis in MATLAB using MATPOWER.
